book.mayhem.lab_notes.page0:
LAB NOTES

If you are reading this, I left in a hurry. Reality is a lot more porous than they teach you.

Step 1: dig deep. Find FLUX CRYSTAL ORE glowing below y=32.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page1:
PORTAL FLUID
Flux Crystal + Slime Ball + Glass Bottle.

PORTAL GUN
Flux, glass, a diamond, iron and some Portal Fluid. See the recipe book.

Each Portal Fluid = 4 shots.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page2:
USING THE GUN
Use: fire. Wherever the blob lands, a portal opens - and a return portal opens on the other side.

Sneak+Use: pick a destination. HOME, the OVERWORLD, the NETHER, THE GLOOPVERSE, THE MEATVERSE, or SCRAMBLE.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page3:
COORDINATE CARDS
Use one on a block to bookmark it. Hold it in your off-hand when you fire to portal straight there.

Tip: crashed saucers in the Overworld hide useful salvage.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page4:
THE GLOOPVERSE
Floating islands of jelly. Low gravity. Friendly Gloopers (tame them with Flux Crystals, ride them on your head!). Wobble Shrooms, flux spires.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page5:
THE MEATVERSE
It is made of meat. Do not sleep there. Meat Crawlers, Watchers and Thought Leeches (sneak quickly to shake one off).

DARK MATTER hides in the gristle deep down.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page6:
CUSTOMS
Open too many portals and Interdimensional Customs will come for you. They confiscate Portal Fluid.

A DIMENSIONAL PERMIT makes them leave you alone. Zorp sells them. Agents sometimes drop them.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page7:
THE OMNI-EYE
Craft EYE BAIT from Watcher Eyes and use it in the Meatverse. Beat the Eye, take its LENS, and build the OMNI PORTAL GUN: unlimited charge, longer portals, and it can reach the End.
book.mayhem.lab_notes.page8:
OTHER TOYS
Size Ray, Quantum Swapper, Plasma Blaster, Pocket Black Holes, Defense Toasters, Interdimensional TV, Mystery Jars...

Good luck. Try not to get audited.
